{{Quote|The station where the heads of state are being held is called Outpost 256.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza|Garza]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Outpost 256''' was an independent fueling and supply [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The outpost was where the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] captured a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Head of State/Legends|Heads of state]] during the [[Galactic War]] to allow Imperial forces to bypass their borders and strike directly at the Republic.<ref name="TOR" />
